_truth_note: No survey truth (2026-10-08): no USGS 3DEP EPT project covers Sunny Isles Beach. USGS_LPC_FL_Southeast_B1_2018_LAS_2019 (Broward, flown 2018-06) stops at ~25.960 N, so it covers 1 of the 42 OSM towers >= 100 m (an unnamed one at 25.9618 N in Golden Beach/Aventura) and none of the Collins Ave strip; Google 3D Tiles are not read (monthly cap). Not in benchmark.REGIONS. The only heights here are the published ones in known_heights_m (single source). Most of the tallest towers (2015-2023) are newer than any 2018 survey anyway.
_bbox_note: Collins Ave tower strip from Haulover (25.918 N) to Golden Beach (25.970 N), Intracoastal side included.
_pending_note: 2026-10-08: drone Photo Spheres confirmed by a one-image screen (free metadata scan of 4257 points within 2 km of the towers, 457 user spheres; 20 screened). Not captured: a 2-row hi-res sphere (15 headings x pitches 8/-18 = 30 Street View images, free allowance, ~$0.21 at list price) each needs approval. In order: Alexandre Pilot 2023-12, over the Intracoastal 613 m W of the towers, ~100 m up, whole Collins Ave skyline in view; Rick Goldman 2022-02, over the beach 171 m from Ritz-Carlton/Trump Towers, ~60-80 m up; Rick Goldman 2022-02, over the sea off Newport pier 186 m from the towers, low, tower row in view; John Abate 2022-06, high over Haulover inlet 426 m S of the towers, looking N along the strip; P Buchwald 2024-04, high over the Turnberry golf course 643 m W, Aventura + Sunny Isles in view. Also drones, further or facing away: John Abate 25.91204,-80.1264 (1.1 km), Rick Goldman 25.9197,-80.12034 (faces S) and 25.96813,-80.12139 (2022-09).
